capture.title: Add a new receipt
capture.subtitle: Photograph a receipt or upload the unchanged original. After extraction, you decide what gets posted.

camera.title: Take a photo
camera.hint: Lay the receipt flat and keep the entire document in frame.

upload.title: Upload a file
upload.drop: Drop a PDF or image here
upload.formats: PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF or HEIF · up to 15 MB

capture.wormHint: The uploaded original is archived immutably. Corrections only change the posting data.

errors.size: The file must be larger than 0 bytes and no more than 15 MB.
errors.type: PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF and HEIF are supported.
errors.upload: The receipt could not be uploaded. Check the file and try again.

notices.uploaded: The receipt was captured safely and will appear in the review list after extraction.
notices.duplicate: This file was already captured and has been marked as a duplicate. Nothing was posted.
notices.quarantined: The file was quarantined during the security scan. It cannot be archived or posted.

mailbox.title: Your receipt email
mailbox.error: The receipt email address is currently unavailable.
mailbox.copyError: Copying failed. Select the address and copy it manually.
mailbox.hint: Forward supplier receipts to this address. Attachments arrive in this tenant-isolated review list.

queue.title: Review receipts
queue.subtitle: Originals, extraction results and posting status at a glance.
queue.error: The receipt list could not be loaded.
queue.empty: There are no receipts with this status.

review.title: Review receipt
review.subtitle: Invoice date {{date}}
review.error: The receipt could not be loaded.
review.fieldsHint: Low or missing confidence is highlighted. Compare every field with the original.
review.validation: Complete the amounts and at least one date. A VAT rate is also required for regular receipts.
review.reviewed: Review saved. The posting proposal is now current.
review.saveError: The review could not be saved.
review.booked: The receipt was confirmed and posted.
review.alreadyBooked: This receipt was already posted. The linked journal entry was loaded.
review.bookError: The receipt could not be posted.

stateHint.0: This receipt is still being extracted. It can be reviewed afterwards.
stateHint.4: This original was identified as a duplicate. You can view it, but it cannot be posted.
stateHint.6: This receipt is quarantined and cannot be reviewed or posted. No valid original was archived.

original.title: Unchanged original
original.unavailable: No viewable original is archived for this record.
original.error: The archived original could not be loaded.
original.previewUnsupported: This file type cannot be previewed directly in the browser.

proposal.title: Posting proposal
proposal.reviewFirst: Save your review first. Until then there is no posting approval.
proposal.error: The posting proposal could not be created.
proposal.unsaved: Fields changed since the last review. Save again before posting.

confirm.title: Human confirmation required
confirm.neverAutomatic: Only this click creates the journal entry. Extraction, e-invoices and review never post automatically.

booking.hint: The receipt is posted; the unchanged original remains permanently viewable alongside it.

payments.title: Payments
payments.hint: Record here when you paid this receipt. Only the payment makes the EÜR recognize the expense on the payment date (cash basis).
payments.loadError: The payments could not be loaded.
payments.reverseConfirm: Really reverse this payment? A reversing entry will be created.
payments.reverseError: The payment could not be reversed.
payments.error: The payment could not be recorded.

validation.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than 0.
validation.amountMax: The amount must not exceed the open amount.
validation.methodInvalid: Please choose a valid payment method.
